svg.text: PaliGemma's mask is a prefix-LM, not a plain causal LM
image and prompt tokens see each other in both directions; only the generated suffix is causal
fully bidirectional - a patch in the top-left
corner may attend to one in the bottom-right,
and the prompt may look at the whole image
strictly causal - the answer the model is
writing must not see its own future
what the inference code actually builds
torch.full((B, Q_Len, Q_Len), 0) - no mask at all
both are correct here: at prefill every token is in
the prefix, and a single new query may attend to
The zero mask is an inference-time shortcut, not a general one. The moment you train on (prefix, suffix) pairs,
or batch sequences of different lengths, you have to build the real prefix-LM mask - which is why the code
asserts torch.all(attention_mask == 1): it refuses to run with padding rather than silently attend to it.
